course.title: Unit 4 Amazing Plants and Animals【例句】

sentences.content: Imagine you go to the supermarket in your area,
sentences.english: Imagine you go to the supermarket in your area
sentences.chinese: 想象一下你去你家附近的超市,

sentences.content: but there are almost no fruits, vegetables, honey, milk, eggs, or chocolate.
sentences.english: but there are almost no fruits , vegetables , honey , milk , eggs , or chocolate
sentences.chinese: 但几乎没有水果、蔬菜、蜂蜜、牛奶、鸡蛋或巧克力。

sentences.content: How would you feel?
sentences.english: How would you feel ?
sentences.chinese: 你会作何感想？

wordDetails.definition: will（过去式）: 表示意愿或假设

sentences.content: Disappointed?
sentences.english: Disappointed ?
sentences.chinese: 失望了吗？

sentences.content: Angry?
sentences.english: Angry ?
sentences.chinese: 生气了？

sentences.content: Sad?
sentences.english: Sad ?
sentences.chinese: 难过吗？

sentences.content: At this moment you realize people, plants, and animals are all connected.
sentences.english: At this moment you realize people , plants , and animals are all connected
sentences.chinese: 此刻你意识到人类、植物和动物都是相互关联的。

sentences.content: We need each other to live, and bees are one of the best examples of this connection.
sentences.english: We need each other to live , and bees are one of the best examples of this connection
sentences.chinese: 我们彼此需要才能生存，而蜜蜂正是这种依存关系的最佳例证之一。

sentences.content: Bees are very hard-working animals, and their greatest work is pollination.
sentences.english: Bees are very hard-working animals , and their greatest work is pollination
sentences.chinese: 蜜蜂是非常勤劳的动物，它们最伟大的工作是授粉。

sentences.content: On one trip, they often visit 50 to 100 flowers.
sentences.english: On one trip , they often visit 50 to 100 flowers
sentences.chinese: 在一次行程中，它们通常会造访50到100朵花。

sentences.content: As they fly from one flower to another, they take pollen with them.
sentences.english: As they fly from one flower to another , they take pollen with them
sentences.chinese: 当它们在花朵间穿梭时，会携带花粉一同传播。

sentences.content: This action helps plants grow.
sentences.english: This action helps plants grow
sentences.chinese: 这一行为有助于植物生长。

wordDetails.definition: help（第三人称单数）: 帮助

sentences.content: In fact, without their work, about 80 per cent of the plants in the world cannot grow.
sentences.english: In fact , without their work , about 80 per cent of the plants in the world cannot grow
sentences.chinese: 事实上，如果没有它们的工作，世界上约80%的植物都无法生长。

sentences.content: For this reason, many scientists believe that bees are the most important animals on this planet.
sentences.english: For this reason , many scientists believe that bees are the most important animals on this planet
sentences.chinese: 正因如此，许多科学家认为蜜蜂是地球上最重要的动物。

sentences.content: Bees are also one of the most interesting animals in the world.
sentences.english: Bees are also one of the most interesting animals in the world
sentences.chinese: 蜜蜂也是世界上最有趣的动物之一。

sentences.content: For example, they work hard together to make their homes.
sentences.english: For example , they work hard together to make their homes
sentences.chinese: 例如，他们齐心协力打造自己的家园。

sentences.content: In order to store honey, they create honeycombs.
sentences.english: In order to store honey , they create honeycombs
sentences.chinese: 为了储存蜂蜜，它们会建造蜂巢。

sentences.content: Another interesting thing about bees is how they communicate.
sentences.english: Another interesting thing about bees is how they communicate
sentences.chinese: 关于蜜蜂另一个有趣的事情是它们如何交流。

sentences.content: When a bee finds new food, it uses a dance to tell the others where and how far away the food is.
sentences.english: When a bee finds new food , it uses a dance to tell the others where and how far away the food is
sentences.chinese: 当蜜蜂发现新的食物时，它会通过舞蹈告知其他同伴食物的位置以及距离有多远。

wordDetails.definition: find（第三人称单数）: 找到
use（第三人称单数）: 使用

sentences.content: Bees play an important part in the ecosystem of our planet.
sentences.english: Bees play an important part in the ecosystem of our planet
sentences.chinese: 蜜蜂在地球生态系统中扮演着重要角色。

sentences.content: However, the number of bees is dropping, and scientists are worried.
sentences.english: However , the number of bees is dropping , and scientists are worried
sentences.chinese: 然而，蜜蜂的数量正在下降，这让科学家们感到担忧。

sentences.content: They need our help, and there is a lot we can do.
sentences.english: They need our help , and there is a lot we can do
sentences.chinese: 他们需要我们的帮助，而我们能做的还有很多。

sentences.content: Think about what you can do to protect one of the most amazing animals on earth.
sentences.english: Think about what you can do to protect one of the most amazing animals on earth
sentences.chinese: 思考一下你能做些什么来保护地球上最神奇的动物之一。
